### AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT Performance to Dominate Your Game

Powered by the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture, the PowerColor Fighter RX 6750 XT graphics card features 40 Compute Units, 96 MB of all new AMD Infinity Cache and 12GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory, is engineered to deliver ultra-high frame rates and ultimate 1440p gaming experience.

### Fighter Makes Your PC Powerful

The PowerColor Fighter RX 6750 XT graphics card is armed with a dual 90mm cooling fan design, a cooler with an enlarged heatsink surface, and Mute Fan Technology which can run in lower temperatures while providing a stable and outstanding high-performance experience.

### Two Ball Bearing - 4X greater longevity

The cooling fan utilizes two-ball bearing technology, increasing the longevity of the fans by up to 4 times.

### Mute Fan Technology - 0db –Silent gaming

Mute Fan Technology intelligently turns off the fan below 60℃, providing silent gaming during medium and low load while reducing power consumption.

### Unprecedented Ring-fan Blade Design

The newest 9-blade design of our fans generate better airflow and air pressure under the same noise level, improving cooling performance to reduce GPU temperatures by more than 3℃ compared to previous generations.

### Dual Cooling Fan

PowerColor Fighter RX 6750 XT graphics card features a 2 X 90mm optimized fan design to maintain your card in the best cooling solution.

### Lower Temperature Better Performance

PowerColor Fighter RX 6750 XT equips with copper heatpipes and an enlarged heatsink surface to provide lower temperature but better performance.

### Copper Base Direct Touch

A smooth copper base directly contacts the GPU to enhance exceptional heat dissipation efficiency, and to keep the card in the optimum cooling condition.

### Performance to Dominate Your Game

The ultimate 1440p game changer. Built on revolutionary AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Powerhouse Performance for 1440p

AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics cards deliver serious 1440p gaming and ultra-high frame rates. Get up to 40 high-performance compute units, groundbreaking AMD Infinity Cache, and up to 12GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory. Experience new levels of gaming performance with AMD Smart Access Memory technology when you pair an AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics card with an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series desktop processor.

### Vivid Visuals

With immersive gaming technologies and support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate, AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics cards draw you into the action. Experience 1440p gaming with realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections along with rich detail, thanks to DirectX® Raytracing (DXR), variable rate shading (VRS), and AMD FidelityFX features, optimized for AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Elevated Experiences

Level up to ultimate responsiveness and smooth gaming with low-latency gaming technology from AMD Radeon™ Anti-Lag and AMD Radeon™ Boost. Enhance your gaming experience with the latest HDMI™ 2.1 VRR technology, with over 1300 AMD FreeSync™ gaming displays to choose from, and support for motherboards with PCIe® 4.0 technology.

### One Gaming DNA for PCs and Consoles

AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture is the foundation of next-generation gaming PCs and consoles. It is the bedrock of the revolution in PC gaming graphics and cloud gaming. AMD RDNA™ 2 elevates and unifies visual effects and gameplay across multi-gaming platforms, like no other graphics architecture before.

Bold in strength yet sleek in design, it features a subtle glow — Arctic Blue — adding personality to your setup.

- Videos

### High-Efficiency DrMOS Power Module

Reduce Power Loss during transmission, Ensure Longer-Lasting Performance and Reliability.

Hellhound features a 5+1 phase power design, along with a dedicated 2+1 phase memory power supply. It is equipped with conductive polymer capacitors, offering thermal stability and durability.

### Premium-Quality PCB

Enhanced Signal Stability for Uninterrupted Performance

Crafted with 10-layer high-thermal conductivity material with a 2oz power layer, ensure better signal stability during high-frequency transmission.

## Exterior Design

### Reinforced Metal Backplate

Durable metal backplate reinforces support to prevent PCB deformation.

### Arctic Blue Glow

Sleek and elegant with Blue LED lighting, easily controlled by a physical switch.

## Experience Cutting-Edge Graphics Card for Gamers / Keeping Heat Under Control

### Dual BIOS

#### Switch between OC (Performance) and Silent modes

Adjustable fan speed to suit your needs while maintaining peak performance.

### Intelligent Fan Control

#### Precise Temperature Sensor

Fan cooling ensures GPU to operate within optimal temperature. The fans kick in at 60°C and stop below 50°C.

### Exclusive Ring Blade Design

#### Fast and Silent.

Designed with 9 blades, enhancing fan speed and airflow while keeping noise level to the minimum.

### Dual Ball Bearings

#### Durable and Reliable

Premium Japanese dual ball bearings to reduce rotational friction, and extend fan lifespan.

## Engineered for Rapid Cooling

### Vertical Heatsink

Designed with larger heat sink and precisely spaced fins for better heat spread and dispersion.

### Honeywell PTM7950

#### Seamless phase-change

Ensures micro gaps between the GPU and heatsink are rapidly filled during high-load operations, significantly enhancing thermal efficiency.

### Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement

#### Rapid & Efficient Heat Transfer

Four 6φ nickel-plated copper heatpipes are aligned above the PCB, optimizing heat transfer from the GPU and VRAM to the cooling array.

### Direct Contact

Featuring a smooth nickel-plated copper base that conducts and distributes heat for efficient GPU and memory cooling.

### DESIGNED FOR LIGHTNING-FAST GAMING, POWERED BY AMD RDNA™ 4

Experience the next level of 1440p gaming performance with AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT graphics cards. Powered by groundbreaking RDNA™ 4 architecture with unified compute units featuring advanced raytracing and AI accelerators, support for AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4 technology and AMD HYPR-RX for ultra-smooth, ultra-responsive gameplay that makes every play count.

### Powerful AI Enhanced Visuals

Enjoy gaming like never before with immersive, lifelike visuals driven by next-gen raytracing, supercharged with AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4 ML-powered upscaling, and elevated streaming clarity by Enhanced Media Engine.

### Performance Made Easy

The AMD Radeon™ RX 9000 Series puts powerful performance at your fingertips with intuitive AMD Software: Adrenaline Edition. Experience dependable feature rich drivers, real-time AI-powered assistance, and one-click optimization with AMD HYPR-RX. Elevate your gaming with increased frame rates, reduced lag, and sharper visuals.

### Future-Ready Tech

Built for longevity, AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT graphics cards feature up to 16GB VRAM, PCI Express® Gen 5 support, AMD Smart Access Memory™ technology, AI-enabled technologies, and seamless pairing with AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series processors to unlock the full potential of your AM5 platform. An updated Radiance Display™ Engine featuring DisplayPort™ 2.1a and HDMI 2.1b is ready for the latest ultra-high refresh displays.

ithardware - Hellhound RX 9060 XT Jeśli chodzi o kartę graficzną od PowerColor, jest to produkt w mojej ocenie przyjemny dla oka, dobrze wykonany i z nienachalnym podświetleniem LED, które w razie potrzeby można łatwo wyłączyć. Chociaż fanów wielobarwnej iluminacji może rozczarować brak RGB. Największą zaletą jest jednak świetne chłodzenie, które zapewnia bardzo dobre temperatury GPU oraz akceptowalne VRAM przy niemal niesłyszalnej pracy. Dlatego karta firmy PowerColor otrzymuje ode mnie ocenę 9/10 oraz wyróżnienie kultura pracy, na które w pełni zasłużyła. More

pcmasters - Hellhound RX 9060 XT Die PowerColor Radeon RX 9060 XT Hellhound ist eine gute Mischung aus Leistung, Effizienz und einem erschwinglichen Preis. Damit soll sie eine Kampfansage an NVIDIA im Preissegment unter 500 Euro darstellen. Dank AMDs Fokus auf Energieeffizienz und solide Gaming-Leistung, insbesondere bei 1080p, kann diese Karte trotz eines leichten Leistungsabfall bei höheren Auflösungen mit der GeForce RTX 4070 und RTX 5060 Ti mithalten. Mit einem geringeren Stromverbrauch, einem schlanken Dual-Slot-Formfaktor und anpassbaren Leistungsprofilen bietet die RX 9060 XT Hellhound ein hervorragendes Preis- Leistungs-Verhältnis zum empfohlenen Preis von 389 Euro.
